length_in.note: Secondary source: C/D 2026 Macan Electric 4 AWD. Porsche USA's Macan Electric pages have no dimensions in text. C/D also lists a 2027 submodel (not fetched).

trims: Macan 4 Electric and three other AWD variants
awd.note: Porsche USA lists 5 model variants for 2027: one 'Rear-wheel-drive', four 'All-wheel-drive'. C/D 2026 trims: 4, 4S, Turbo, GTS (AWD) and base RWD.

charge_port.note: Porsche USA's Macan Electric page doesn't name the connector; 'CCS fast charging station' appears only in a charge-time test footnote.

us_status.note: Porsche USA lists 2027 variants with prices, 'Build Your Porsche' and 'New and Used Inventory' links.
